#### Problem & Root Cause
When deleting a single authentication method ([`AuthInfo`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-1/apps/iam/pkg/apis/iam/v0alpha1/authinfo_spec_gen.go#L22-L26)) entry for a user, setups routing requests through legacy storage (DualWriter modes 0–3) failed with a `405 Method Not Supported` error. [`LegacyStore.Delete`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-1/pkg/registry/apis/iam/authinfo/store.go#L326-L328) had a hardcoded `apierrors.NewMethodNotSupported(...)` return value, whereas modern unified storage already supported single-item deletes. Furthermore, [`login.Store`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-1/pkg/services/login/authinfo.go#L19-L27) only had a bulk `DeleteUserAuthInfo` method (which wiped all auth methods for a user), lacking a method to remove an individual `(user_id, auth_module)` entry.

1. **AuthInfo Model & Command:**
   - In [`DeleteAuthInfoCommand`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-1/pkg/services/login/model.go#L93-L97), added `UserId int64` and `AuthModule string` fields alongside `UserAuth *UserAuth`.

2. **Login Services & Stores:**

   - In [`authinfoimpl.Store`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-1/pkg/services/login/authinfoimpl/store.go#L352-L383), implemented `DeleteAuthInfo` to delete only the matching row for `(user_id, auth_module)` from the `user_auth` database table.
   - In [`authinfoimpl.Service`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-1/pkg/services/login/authinfoimpl/service.go#L195-L225), implemented `DeleteAuthInfo` delegating to the underlying store and invalidating the corresponding remote cache entry.
   - In [`authinfok8s.Store`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-1/pkg/services/login/authinfok8s/authinfo.go#L278-L316), implemented `DeleteAuthInfo` using the k8s resource client.
   - Updated test mocks/fakes in [`MockAuthInfoStore`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-1/pkg/services/login/authinfotest/auth_info_store_mock.go#L36-L53), [`MockAuthInfoService`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-1/pkg/services/login/authinfotest/auth_info_service_mock.go#L36-L53), and [`FakeService`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-1/pkg/services/login/authinfotest/fake.go#L60-L68).

The registry is passed into the server in pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go (`searchFields: searchFields`) from SearchOptions in pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go (`SearchFields: searchFields`).

In pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go, the lookup specifically queries the exact group and resource pair: `selectableFields, _, _ := searchFields.For(NewLowerGroupResource(req.Options.Key.Group, req.Options.Key.Resource))`. In pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go, entries are keyed per kind/resource: `fields[NewLowerGroupResource(m.Group, ManifestResourceName(v))] = fs`.

In pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go, every field in req.Options.Fields is checked in a loop: `for _, f := range req.Options.Fields { fieldName := strings.TrimPrefix(f.Key, SEARCH_SELECTABLE_FIELDS_PREFIX); if !slices.Contains(selectableFields, fieldName) { return false } }`.

In pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go, if a field is not declared searchable or the kind has no selectable fields, it returns false to trigger storage scan: `if len(selectableFields) == 0 { return false }` and `if !slices.Contains(selectableFields, fieldName) { return false }`.

When SearchFields is absent/unset (nil), pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go synthesizes a registry from AppManifests(): `if searchFields == nil { manifests := MergeManifestsByKind(AppManifests()); selectable, hashes, providers, _ := SearchFieldsForManifests(manifests...); searchFields = NewSearchFieldsRegistry(selectable, hashes, providers) }`. Furthermore, pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go falls back to `defaultSearchFieldsRegistry()`, which also loads AppManifests(). Thus, requests filtering on fields declared in AppManifests() evaluate to true and are sent to the index instead of falling back to storage scan.

In pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go, requests with no field selectors return true immediately before examining any field declarations: `if len(req.Options.Fields) == 0 { return true }`.

In pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go, SearchFieldsRegistry initialization was moved outside `if cfg.EnableSearch`, and is populated and returned even when local search is disabled: `searchFields := resource.NewSearchFieldsRegistry(selectableFields, searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders)` and `return resource.SearchOptions{ SearchFields: searchFields, ... }`.

In pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go, when `docs == nil`, mapping hashes and providers are set to nil while selectable fields remain populated: `if docs == nil || !cfg.EnableSearch { searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders = nil, nil }` and `searchFields := resource.NewSearchFieldsRegistry(selectableFields, searchFieldsHashes, searchFieldsProviders)`.

### Summary of Changes

We updated the resource listing logic so that filtering by field selectors relies on live, declared searchable fields rather than a static, compiled-in list of built-in apps, and verifies every field in the filter before routing to search.

---

### What Was Changed and Why

1. **Live Selectable Fields Lookup & Per-Field Validation in [`shouldUseSearchForList`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go#L365-L423)**
   - **Previous Behavior**: Checked the request's `Group` against a static set of manifests compiled into the binary (`AppManifestsWithKinds(AppManifests()...)`), ignoring dynamically installed/updated apps. It also only checked the group name rather than validating whether the queried fields were actually declared as searchable. Querying an undeclared field routed to the search index and returned 0 hits rather than falling back to scanning storage.
   - **New Behavior**: Retrieves the live [`SearchFieldsRegistry`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go#L95) via [`getSearchFields()`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors.go#L425-L433). Queries [`searchFields.For(...)`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go#L143) for the requested group/resource, and checks that **every** field selector in `req.Options.Fields` is present in the declared selectable fields. If any field is undeclared or unknown, it safely falls back to scanning storage (`return false`).

2. **Registry Availability in All Deployment Modes (including Delegated Search)**
   - **[`pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go#L55-L72)**: Moved [`SearchFieldsRegistry`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go#L95) initialization outside the `if cfg.EnableSearch` block in [`NewSearchOptions`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/search/options.go#L44). When local search is disabled (`cfg.EnableSearch = false`) because search is delegated to a separate service (`s.searchClient != nil`), `SearchOptions.SearchFields` is still created and populated.
   - **[`pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go#L593-L626)**: Added `searchFields *SearchFieldsRegistry` to [`server`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go#L713), initializing it from `opts.Search.SearchFields` in [`NewUninitializedResourceServer`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go#L588) so the server can inspect declared fields dynamically regardless of backend topology.

3. **Manifest Resource Name Aliasing**
   - **[`pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go#L77-L84)**: In [`selectableFieldsForManifest`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go#L72), added [`ManifestResourceName(v)`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/selectable_fields.go#L80) alongside `v.Kind` and `v.Plural` in the fields map so lookups succeed consistently whether callers identify the resource by kind or by plural name.

4. **Tests**
   - **[`pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors_test.go`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors_test.go#L170-L305)**: Added test cases in [`TestShouldUseSearchForList`](file:///Users/yoavshmariahu/src/thinker/.worktrees/gemini-intro-v2/bench/worktrees/grafana-grafana-gemini-intro-ab-v2-0/pkg/storage/unified/resource/list_with_selectors_test.go#L170) verifying:
